axioms.name: INITIATION
axioms.description: Declare the beginning. Name what is starting, why, and who owns it. Nothing starts without this.

requirements.prompt: What is starting (one sentence)?
Why is it starting?
Who owns this build?

axioms.name: IMMUTABILITY
axioms.description: Make loss impossible. Version everything from day one; nothing vanishes without a trace.

requirements.prompt: Where does the code/decision history live (repo, path)?
Evidence of a first commit or equivalent versioned artifact.

axioms.name: NAMING
axioms.description: Name everything once, clearly. Later confusion is almost always a naming failure now.

requirements.prompt: The chosen name and who chose it.
A short glossary of terms this build will use consistently.

axioms.name: ORDERING
axioms.description: Structure before content. Decide what goes where and what gets built first, foundation-first.

requirements.prompt: The directory/module layout, foundation first.
The order pieces get built in, and why.

axioms.name: ADVERSITY
axioms.description: Invite the enemy early. Test plan and failure modes before they find you.

requirements.prompt: Named failure modes.
How each failure mode is caught or prevented.

axioms.name: FIDELITY
axioms.description: Stay faithful to the purpose. The build must match what INITIATION promised; no drift.

requirements.prompt: What is the source of truth for scope, and where does it live?
Evidence the current build still matches INITIATION's promise.

axioms.name: MIGRATION
axioms.description: Bring the old world in safely. Data, users, dependencies move on a plan, not on hope.

requirements.prompt: What is being inherited (data, users, dependencies, prior projects)?
The plan for carrying each inherited thing forward.

axioms.name: RECOVERY
axioms.description: Plan the undo before you need it. Backups and rollback. No launch without a way back.

requirements.prompt: Where backups live and how they're taken.
The stated rollback procedure for this build.

axioms.name: PROTOCOL
axioms.description: Write down how the pieces talk to each other, so a stranger could use this and pick it up.

requirements.prompt: How the pieces (or people) talk to each other.
Where a stranger would go to pick this up.

axioms.name: REST
axioms.description: Define done. A project with no definition of done never rests; it just burns fuel forever.

requirements.prompt: The concrete, checkable definition of done for this build.
Evidence the definition of done has actually been met.
